verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs describe an in-app AI palette (cmd+j) that runs on your notes, with built-in prompts such as 'list key takeaways' and 'list action-items', plus custom prompts and a choice of GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. You can also 'chat' with a filtered set of notes to ask questions and extract information, and semantic search finds information without exact wording. Missing for 10: proactive or unprompted AI suggestions surfaced without the user invoking them, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features' quality.
